title: Rollout Gatekeeper Tracker - Inference Implementation
summary: Lightweight spreadsheet-style tracker used by CS + Solutions to gate customers through discovery, pilot, and production for inference rollouts. Focused on milestone owners, explicit blockers, risk to renewal, and action items for the next two weeks.

Environment Validation - Validate VPC peering & egress rules (owner: Ethan Brooks) - due: 2025-11-20 - status: blocked (network ACL mismatch)
Pilot - 2-week pilot with 1 endpoint & metrics collection (owner: Diego Martínez) - due: 2025-12-15 - status: in_progress
Scale Qualification - Throughput test at target QPS (owner: Maya Singh) - due: 2026-01-10 - status: pending
Production Onboarding - Migration runbook & canary deploy (owner: Ava Chen) - due: 2026-02-01 - status: pending
Post-GoLive Validation - Error budget review & cost tuning (owner: Priya Nair) - due: 2026-02-15 - status: pending
current_blockers: Network ACLs in customer account block egress to telemetry endpoint - blocker_owner: Customer NetOps - mitigation: SRE to propose NAT gateway config by 2026-03-05

renewal_risk_assessment: medium - pilot metrics will determine path to expansion; network and DPA delays increase churn risk if pilot slips >6 weeks

Prepare a short cost delta slide showing expected cost per 1M tokens across quantization choices
Document open blockers and ask for AE presence during QBR to accelerate DPA sign-off
